hypothesis: The treatment model will identify higher-risk users more effectively than the non-ML recency baseline on held-out logged data.
minimum_effect_basis: A 5% relative effect is the preregistered minimum practical effect for the replay comparison.
ship_rule: Production shipment requires preregistered statistical guardrails AND genuine production/live causal evidence.
online_validation_requirement: Offline replay cannot establish causal online intervention impact.
data_policy: Current verified dataset is synthetic_demo and must not be presented as production evidence.
